sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of What Letter is It? lies its simple yet engaging gameplay. Players are presented with a series of images, each associated with a specific letter of the alphabet. The objective is to identify the correct letter by scrolling through the alphabet and clicking on the correct letter. The game features a variety of images, ranging from animals to objects, making it an excellent learning tool for young minds.

The gameplay is straightforward, with players having to scroll through the alphabet quickly to identify the correct letter before time runs out. The game's difficulty level increases as players progress through the levels, with more images and letters being introduced. This makes it challenging yet engaging, encouraging players to keep improving their knowledge.

One of the standout features of What Letter is It? is its ability to adapt to the player's skill level. As players progress, the game adjusts the difficulty level accordingly, ensuring that the gameplay remains engaging and challenging.
